payload.summary: Fresh field evidence for the handoff-document direction (Jim relayed dev-agent finding, chat 2026-08-19): a mega-prompt dispatch to codex HUNG (0.08s CPU flatline signature), while the same review re-dispatched as a one-sentence pointer prompt to a handoff doc (docs/handoffs/pr25-round2-review-brief.md) ran healthy (climbing CPU). Confirms the risk applies to nahel dispatch as built: composeInvocation (src/dispatch/invocation.ts) passes orientation preamble + full task as ONE trailing argv argument, so task size is bounded only by what the caller inlines after the dispatch separator — nothing steers large context into a document. The approved 2026-07-28 design (journal f4v1wt9m: dispatcher-written nahel/runs/<run-id>/task.md, pointer prompt, worker-written result.md, journal records paths) is exactly the fix; afk-run/review-loop workflow prose should canonize pointer-prompt dispatch once this plan item lands.
